NOTIFICATION 

Date: 18 December 2024 

No.  BSEC/CMRRCD/2009-193/85/PRD/153Whereas 
the  Bangladesh  Securities  and 
Exchange Commission (hereinafter referred to as "the Commission") deems it appropriate to 
exempt certain issuer from the provisions of clause (u) of rule 8 and rule 14 of the Securities and 
Exchange  Commission  (Right  Issue)  Rules,  2006  in  order  to  raise  paid-up  capital  through  right 
share offer. 

Now,  therefore,  in  exercise  of  the  powers  conferred  by  section  29  of  the  Securities  and 
Exchange  Ordinance, 1969 (Ordinance  No.  XVII  of  1969),  the  Commission hereby  exempts 
Berger  Paints Bangladesh  Ltd. from  the provisions of  clause (u) of rule 8 and rule 14 of the 
Securities  and  Exchange  Commission  (Right  Issue)  Rules,  2006  in  order  to  raise  paid-up 
capital  from  463.78  (mn)  to  491.06  (mn)  through  issuing  right  share  subject  to  comply  all 
other requirements of the Securities and Exchange Commission (Right Issue) Rules, 2006. 

By order of the Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission. 

KHONDOKER RASHED MAQSOOD 
Chairman.
